Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this on. Halo Health is starting a CAIQ review ahead of our vendor approval board next month and we need a lightweight, tiered evidence package to validate control coverage.

We also need a named signer for the CAIQ attestation (DocuSign) — legal prefers a security or compliance leader who can attest to controls and artifacts. Please let us know who will sign and if you need a delegated signer.

Attached: Halo_CAIQ_Request_20270531.pdf (questionnaire & scope)

Would appreciate a short plan of what you can deliver and timeline. If helpful we can do a 30-min sync tomorrow.

Thanks,
Carlos
